title: Board Handle Link Drag Snap And Preview
summary: Implemented handle-to-handle linking in the WASM BoardHost: left-button drag from a handle past a small screen threshold shows a snapped rubber-band preview (open polyline in screen space) and commits a new edge with edgeCreate JSON on release over a snap target. Added BoardScene.ingestWasmEdge and applyWasmDrainToScene edgeCreate handling so the imperative TS scene stays aligned with WASM without double edgeCreate emissions. Rebuilt elements_board wasm; added Rust host tests and a Vitest pointer-drag integration test.
